purpose: Estimate checked per-core cost before scheduling all 13776 fixed 41-vertex cores.
sampling_rule: Eight approximately equally spaced catalog lines; two deletion labels per line, shifted across the 0..41 range.
solver_mode: C++ exhaustive DPLL tree with CORE2DP2 proof output

acceptance.SAT: Persist the raw model immediately, reconstruct the 43-vertex graph, and require both independent graph verifiers.
acceptance.UNSAT: Require the independent Python checker to reconstruct the selected fixed core and replay the complete proof tree.
acceptance.LIMIT: No conclusion; retain the partial trace only as diagnostic data.

decision_rule: Stop and preserve any dual-verified SAT construction.
Do not schedule the full classification if any model verification or proof check fails.
If any pilot core reaches a limit, first run a separately planned limit-scaling pilot.
Otherwise estimate the full checked wall time from observed batch and per-instance timings, then use resumable catalog-line chunks.
scope_warning: A checked UNSAT result excludes only its selected fixed 41-vertex core. Even all 13776 results would not be global order-43 UNSAT.
